entries.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Requested 1536x1024 landscape, three equal horizontal panels left to right, full body and all props visible, same scale and fixed three-quarter camera. No captions, letters, numbers or arrows. Opaque neutral warm grey backdrop with only a small dry quay ground patch and SAME stationary EMPTY two-wheel wooden handcart in back of each panel. Leave a broad visibly empty ground strip down the RIGHT side leading from cart area to foreground shore exit in ALL frames. Sela is exactly the reference adult woman: brown practical bun/loose forelocks, short dark teal shoulder cape, oatmeal rolled sleeves, grey-brown trousers, wide brown belt with small rope coil fixed at hip, brown boots. Action uses ONE CLOSED LONG plain wooden box, chest-high length but only shin-high depth, one lid closed throughout, no contents. LEFT: she bends modestly and holds the near upper end of this box low, opposite end supported on ground, box angled diagonally just ahead of the cart. MIDDLE: she lowers and turns that SAME box crosswise directly in front of cart wheels, keeping both hands on upper edges and one end ground-supported. RIGHT: box is fully resting crosswise on dry ground across only the cart approach, BOTH hands clearly released with air gaps above box; Sela stands at box's left. Box blocks cart motion but NOT the open side path at right. Same box size, grain and closed lid; same cart scale, location, wheel positions, ground strip and viewpoint. Do not draw additional ropes or move her hip coil. No other people, no Yani, medical apparatus, braces, weapons, violence, opened lid, secrets, payment, transport completion, consent symbols or decorative inventory. A finite set-down ending in hold, not a resetting loop. Readable weight-bearing and hand contact matter more than extra detail; this is a concept board, not engine animation.
